## Type

- [ ] Policy pack (`policies/<stack>/AGENT_POLICY.md` + listed in `policies/README.md`)
- [ ] Keel-compatible implementation (link + targets a stated SPEC version)
- [ ] Spec change (`SPEC.md`) — bump the spec version if required behavior changes
- [ ] Skill / command / hook change (bump version in `plugin.json` **and** `marketplace.json`, update `CHANGELOG.md`)
- [ ] Docs only

## Checklist

- [ ] No project-, client-, or company-specific data added to any skill (specifics belong in the consumer's `AGENT_POLICY.md`)
- [ ] If a skill changed, its concept stays disjoint from the other skills
- [ ] Attribution preserved (MIT notice / `NOTICE`)
- [ ] `validate` workflow passes
